entities.summary: Helena Bonciani Nader is a Brazilian biomedical scientist based at the Federal University of São Paulo. She served as president of the Brazilian Society for the Advancement of Science from 2011 to 2017. She works in glycobiology, specialising in the characterisation of proteoglycans. She is a member of The World Academy of Sciences. Helena Nader was a naturalists & biologists from São Paulo (b. 1947-11-05, São Paulo). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to environmental history.
